ideas.pitch: A Python toolkit designed to detect hidden payloads and steganographic data concealed within image and file latents, leveraging mechanistic interpretation techniques.
ideas.title: StegLatentAnalyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the advanced mechanistic interpretation patterns from successful projects like patchsteg, tackling the hardest steganography challenges directly.

ideas.pitch: A network packet capture analysis tool that ingests PCAP files and visualizes anomalous traffic and potential intrusions in real-time 3D space.
ideas.title: NetPulse 3D PCAP
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the real-time threat visualization engine concepts from GraphGuard to make complex network forensics instantly intuitive for judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated binary analysis and decompilation helper that detects common obfuscation patterns and maps out control flow graphs for reverse engineering tasks.
ideas.title: RevArmor Binary Deobfuscator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves genuine hard engineering problems in binary analysis under tight time constraints, addressing a domain where automation stands out.

ideas.pitch: A specialized reconnaissance automation script that securely crawls public data registries and metadata layers to surface hidden configuration flags and leaks.
ideas.title: OSINT Footprint Aggregator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses automated data ingestion pipelines reminiscent of WILDSCAN to rapidly parse complex unstructured information sources during live CTF challenges.

ideas.pitch: A rapid custom static analysis extension tailored to uncover modern web exploitation vectors like prototype pollution and insecure deserialization in custom applications.
ideas.title: WebVuln Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on the reporting and analysis automation mindset of tools like reportr, giving competitors a tactical edge during the 6-hour time window.
